info.name: TOEIC Pro — E2E Service Communication Tests
info.description:
Bộ test khép kín kiểm tra giao tiếp giữa 7 microservices trong hệ thống TOEIC Pro.

Các flow chính:
1. OAuth2 Token (Keycloak)
2. Subscription Service (Plan + Subscription CRUD)
3. Payment Service (Payment Transaction → Kafka publish)
4. Kafka Event → Subscription Service (auto-activate)
5. Exam Service → Subscription Service (Feign check)
6. Course Service (Course/Chapter/Lesson CRUD)
7. User Service (UserProfile CRUD)
8. Notification Service (Notification CRUD)
